item.title: Agents on one machine authenticate by co-location. I wanted signatures instead.
item.description: Keryx is a local signed message bus where every message carries an ed25519 signature — the agent never holds its key, so a prompt-injected agent cannot impersonate another.

item.title: OpenNote: Private, Local-First AI Study Tool for Your Documents
item.description: Turn your PDFs and notes into a cited, private study assistant. OpenNote runs locally, cites every answer, and supports free Colab/Kaggle GPU hosting.
